task_title: Automate NT8: compile + backtest ORB with no clicks
task_details:
User 2026-09-11: backtest in NinjaTrader 8 directly with NT8's own metrics; user must not press anything in NT8. ORB only first. Research + plan: docs/research/nt8-automation-notes.md (StrategyBase.RunBacktest() public; AddOn job-folder runner; auto-compile on file save while NinjaScript Editor open; ES 1m history not in NT db yet).
[2026-09-11T08:41:15.683136+00:00 -> open] Built tools/nt_export: Databento ES 1m parquet -> NT8 import text (yearly .txt files, data/nt_import/, America/Chicago timestamps). No new data account/trial or MultiCharts needed - we already own the 1m history. Next: import into a dedicated backtest-only NT8 instrument, verify timezone against NT8 chart settings, then build Orb.cs + BacktestRunner AddOn.
[2026-09-11T09:03:21.631642+00:00 -> open] 2026-09-11: confirmed via NT8 forum - no headless API for instrument creation or data import (Import Wizard's .ncd conversion and instrument creation are both GUI-only/unsupported to script). User considered switching to MT5 to avoid manual clicks; rejected - Tradovate (what Lucid runs on) has no MT5 integration, so MT5 backtests would be disconnected from the live venue, defeating the reason we left Python. Decision: stay on NT8. One-time manual setup remains: (1) create custom instrument ESBT in NT8 GUI, (2) Tools > Import Data with data/nt_import/ES_1m_*.txt (Minute, Timestamp;Open;High;Low;Close;Volume), (3) confirm Tools > Options > General > Time Zone matches America/Chicago (files exported in that tz - CME session templates are in Central time). User has not yet done these 3 steps or reported the timezone setting back. After that: write Orb.cs (standard OCO stop-entry ORB, both-sides-bar question already resolved - see task #2 latest note) + BacktestRunner AddOn.
[2026-09-13T23:30:44.807341+00:00 -> open] 2026-09-14: wrote ninjascript/Strategies/Orb.cs (vanilla ORB step 1: OCO stop entries hi/lo of range, other-side stop, 0.5R target, 1 trade/day, flat-by, news-block via CSV, max-stop-points cap) + ninjascript/deploy.ps1 (copies into NT8 bin/Custom + drops news_usd_high.csv) + tools/nt_export --news (data/news/usd_high.csv ET -> Central CSV for the strategy). NOT compiled/tested yet - no headless NT8 compiler here; needs the 3 pending manual GUI steps (create ESBT instrument, import data/nt_import/ES_1m_*.txt, confirm NT8 Time Zone = America/Chicago) plus opening NinjaScript Editor once to trigger a compile. Two assumptions flagged in Orb.cs comments to verify once compiled: bar timestamp = close-time labeling, and CT=ET-1h. Next: user runs deploy.ps1 + does the 3 manual steps, then compile + Strategy Analyzer run, then build BacktestRunner AddOn for the no-click automation.
